verdict.rationale: The firm's own "Lowenstein x Clerky" page describes a named program for startup formation with some stated pricing (e.g., $299 post-incorporation setup, $149 83(b) election add-on), satisfying the 'named program with stated terms' branch of the story. However, the base incorporation/formation fee itself and any deferred-fee arrangement are not quantified, so the package is only partially transparent. Missing for 10: explicit fixed fee for the core incorporation/formation service, and any stated deferred-fee terms.
